name: mamba_layernorm_gated
description: Mamba gated normalization. x is [M,N]; weight and bias have N elements; group_size defaults to N and must divide N. If is_rms_norm, normalize over each group by sqrt(mean(x^2)+eps); otherwise subtract the group mean first (LayerNorm). If z is provided, apply SiLU(z)=z*sigmoid(z) either before normalization (norm_before_gate=False) or after the affine transform (norm_before_gate=True). bias may be None. Output has x's shape/dtype. The native kernel specializes hidden_size=4096/group_size=128 and otherwise uses a generic grouped kernel. Returns a new tensor. Current tests exercise bfloat16 with N 64..4096, group sizes 64/128, both norm modes and the no-z case.
